about: Per-row source text and flags for the tables built from this section. ACTINV does not read this file; it records what a coefficient table cannot express. Superscripts in cell text are written ^{...}.

source.citation: 49 CFR 173.436 (US Code of Federal Regulations, Title 49)
source.edition: eCFR text current as of 2026-10-13; CFR history [69 FR 3685, Jan. 26, 2004, as amended at 79 FR 40615, July 11, 2014; 80 FR 72928, Nov. 23, 2015]; values are those of IAEA SSR-6 (Rev.1), 2018 edition, as incorporated by 49 CFR 171.7
source.jurisdiction: United States (49 CFR Part 173, transport of radioactive material)
source.scope: Transport of radioactive material. A1/A2 and exempt values are not clearance, waste classification or dose limits; choosing this table is a regulatory decision for the analyst.
source.licence: US Government work (17 U.S.C. 105), public domain. The values mirror IAEA SSR-6 (Rev.1) Table 2 as published in 49 CFR.
